label: Active voice
description: Prefer active voice over passive voice in customer-facing content.
expected_behaviour: Flag clearly passive constructions and suggest active rewrites.

examples.text: Our team resolves tickets in under four minutes.
Tickets are resolved by our team in under four minutes.

label: Avoid filler phrases
description: Remove filler phrases such as 'please note that', 'it is important to', 'in order to'.
expected_behaviour: Flag filler phrases and suggest direct alternatives.

examples.text: To start your trial, click here.
In order to start your trial, please click here.
